fields.label: QR Prefix
fields.description: Prefix reserved for future generated QR identifiers.

fields.label: QR Expiry Duration (Hours)
fields.description: Number of hours before QR is considered expired when validation is enabled.

fields.label: QR Size
fields.description: QR box size used when generating QR images.

fields.label: QR Error Correction Level
fields.description: Error correction level for generated QR images.

fields.label: Enable Mobile Scanner
fields.description: Allow mobile scanner routes for QR operations.

fields.label: Enable Desktop Scanner
fields.description: Allow desktop scanner routes for QR operations.

fields.label: Auto Open Camera
fields.description: Open scanner camera automatically where browser permissions allow.

fields.label: Auto Scan Delay (ms)
fields.description: Delay in milliseconds before accepting repeated scans.

fields.label: Prevent Duplicate Scan
fields.description: Prevent duplicate scan submissions in a short time window.

fields.label: Validate QR Expiry
fields.description: Reject scans when the QR has passed its configured expiry.

fields.label: Prevent Reuse
fields.description: Reject reuse after visitor has checked out.
